For effective connectivity, stay connected with ultra-fast Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4 for reliable wireless performance, the USB-C (USB 3.2 Gen 1, 5Gbps) port supports charging, DisplayPort output, and audio, while the 3-point Pogo Pin connector enables seamless compatibility with supported accessories, and you can connect even more devices with the included 7-in-1 USB-C hub that provides expanded connectivity for monitors, storage devices, and everyday peripherals, plus the included keyboard delivers a comfortable, laptop-like typing experience for everyday productivity. Versatile for everyday life, the Lenovo Yoga Tab is ideal for creators, students, professionals, remote workers, and frequent travelers, built for note-taking, sketching, photo editing, document review, video conferencing, streaming, and multitasking, and whether you're working, learning, creating, or relaxing at home, in the office, in the classroom, or on the go, its AI-powered features and premium design deliver a smooth, versatile experience for every day.
